title: Unix platform attestor: the OS as an iaa1 identity source
description:
hired has eight attestors and every one needs something extra running: an agent, a token in a port, a cloud account, Tailscale. On a bare box it enumerates nothing and issues nothing, which is worse than the status quo -- the app that would have called getuid() still calls getuid(), minus the provenance label, the pseudonym and the audience binding.

SPEC-HIRE.md:373 already places 'local username' at iaa1, alongside SSH and GPG keys. The code dropped it: assurance.rs:29 documents Iaa1 as 'SSH key, GPG key, or DID'. This implements a line of the spec that was never built.

Requires a fourth Evidence variant (PlatformAssertion), because Claim::derive needs Evidence and none of Possession/IdpVerified/HardwarePresence fit a kernel statement.
design:
Evidence::PlatformAssertion tiers to (Iaa1, PresenceLevel::None, asked_at) -- same rung as Possession, per the spec.

PresenceLevel::None, not Session: getuid() says a process runs under an account, not that a human is logged in at a seat. Reading logind/utmp to justify Session is a separate claim and a separate bead.

Accepted cost: Evidence stops meaning 'something cryptographic happened' and starts meaning 'something outside this process attested it'.

Accepted consequence: this attestor cannot be unavailable, so hired now always issues. Consumers that treat 'got a credential' as 'authenticated' rather than reading the assurance field get a weaker answer than when the daemon declined. That makes hire_min_assurance load-bearing.
acceptance_criteria: unix attestor enumerates the current user via getpwuid(getuid()); prove() yields PlatformAssertion; credential carries iaa1 + presence none + sources ['unix']; assurance.rs doc comment restored to match SPEC-HIA.md:373; tests use an independent oracle (getent/id), never the code under test.
notes: IMPLEMENTATION IS DONE as of 2026-09-15; this stays open only as the parent of 9 open children. hire-attestors/src/unix.rs ships UnixAttestor with enumerate() over getpwuid_r/getuid and prove() returning Evidence::PlatformAssertion, registered unconditionally under cfg(unix) and deliberately last so an always-available iaa1 source cannot take the winning-tier slot. Covered by tests/unix_account_live.rs and tests/unix_account_bare_env.rs against the real passwd database with 'id' as the oracle. Close this when its children are resolved; do not force-close over them.
